title: Model DOS INT 21h AH=35h and AH=25h interrupt vector services
description: Continue original-byte DOS/4GW startup after DPMI AX=0200. Implement DOS get/set interrupt vector with an explicit real-mode vector table and ABI-correct ES:BX output. Capture the current target input (measured AX=3508 at 0x001C8CDF), test configured/unconfigured vectors and preservation/error behavior, then rerun the empty-config -k oracle to the next gate.
acceptance: AH=35h vector 8 request returns the documented host vector pair with correct ES:BX and CF behavior
AH=25h updates explicit DOS vector state without changing unrelated vectors
Unit tests cover configured, unconfigured and round-trip cases
Original-byte -k resumes past 0x001C8CDF and records the next exact gate
No MENU/gameplay claim is made without corresponding target evidence
